Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-slack-medium-0013", "row_sha256": "95ad6831efbfb9120b8bcdd52a358396f039a835de6e6b0041fe617e41d89907", "mode": "/slack", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Fix grammar, punctuation, and shorthand with minimal edits. Keep casual tone, contractions, emoji, and the original request. Return correct text unchanged.", "input": "hey folks, can someone do the ventilation check in the woodshop before the afternoon class on thursday? the facilities sheet says the extraction fans were serviced monday, but we still need to check them at the bench and spray booth, not just tick the sheet. please note the airflow reading at both points and whether the paper strip pulls steadily toward each grille. if both readings are at least 8 air changes per hour and there's no visible dust hanging around either area, leave both areas open for class and add the numbers to the log. otherwise, if either reading is under 8 or dust is still hanging around that point, close only the affected area and put a note on the door. don't run the spray booth if its own check doesn't pass; the bench can still be used if its reading meets the limit and there's no dust there. if the booth passes but the bench doesn't, keep the bench closed and use the booth only if there's no dust there either. could you post the readings here too? thanks!", "output": "Hey folks, can someone do the ventilation check in the woodshop before the afternoon class on Thursday? The facilities sheet says the extraction fans were serviced Monday, but we still need to check them at the bench and spray booth, not just tick the sheet. Please note the airflow reading at both points and whether the paper strip pulls steadily toward each grille. If both readings are at least 8 air changes per hour and there's no visible dust hanging around either area, leave both areas open for class and add the numbers to the log. Otherwise, if either reading is under 8 or dust is still hanging around that point, close only the affected area and put a note on the door. Don't run the spray booth if its own check doesn't pass; the bench can still be used if its reading meets the limit and there's no dust there. If the booth passes but the bench doesn't, keep the bench closed and use the booth only if there's no dust there either. Could you post the readings here too? Thanks!"}]
